_metadata.description: Tiered exposure broker: CORE always-on exposure from api-core/coreset and LEASED on-demand exposure (request/extend/revoke/reap), ensure-running delegation, plus budget-aware and usage-based controls.

requirements.title: Guarantee every core-set scenario is always exposed
requirements.description: Reconciliation ensures every scenario in packages/api-core/coreset has a CORE-tier route that is never auto-expired, recreating it if missing.

requirements.title: Request, extend, revoke, and reap time-bounded leases
requirements.description: A leased exposure is created with a default TTL (~1 week), can be extended and revoked, and a reaper removes expired leases plus their ingress unless the scenario is also CORE.

requirements.title: Expose a scenario on demand via the exposure-request API
requirements.description: Another scenario or the operator can call Expose(scenario, ttl) over the API to create a LEASED route, recording requested_by, and receive the resulting exposure state.

requirements.title: Ensure the scenario is running via the lifecycle seam when exposing
requirements.description: Exposing a scenario ensures it is running by delegating to the internal/lifecycle seam rather than reimplementing process management; a substitutable seam lets tests assert the delegation.

requirements.title: Track hostname budget and evict LRU idle leased routes near the cap
requirements.description: The broker tracks exposed-hostname count against the Cloudflare cap, warns near the cap, and evicts the least-recently-used expired/idle LEASED routes to make room, never evicting CORE routes.

requirements.title: Spin down idle leased scenarios before TTL based on usage
requirements.description: A LEASED route with no observed usage for a configured idle window is spun down before its TTL expiry, freeing the hostname while leaving CORE routes untouched.
